item.title: Design a Search Autocomplete System
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: Suggestions in under 100ms, on every keystroke, for 10 million users. Tries with cached top-k, why the ranking happens offline, the trending-query problem the weekly rebuild cannot solve, and the client-side trick that removes three quarters of your traffic.
